title: Consistency Pact
concept: Private Words→Intent→Proof→Change loop that shrinks the integrity gap without requiring performance for a partner.
whenToUse: Weekly personal integrity practice; after emotional promising; alongside shared Proof during rebuild.
steps: Words — What do I say I value? Write it.
Intent — What did I intend this week?
Proof — What did I actually do? Where was the gap?
Change — One observable behaviour next week.
Keep private unless invited — privacy protects honesty.
Does not replace shared Proof on live breaches.
working: Value: repair within 24h. Missed once. Change: same-day micro-repair text. Next week met. Gap shrinks; partner feels it.
notWorking: Secret moral theatre while refusing shared Proof on a breach. Private practice complements accountability — does not replace it.
activity: Draft private pact. Run three weekly self-assessments.
